_comment: Lane RELEASE-1: the known issues a tester meets, for README_TESTERS.txt (tools/release/readme_testers.py). Each item names the docs/STOPS.md rows it comes from; the generator copies their Area and fails when a row is gone (the issue was resolved or renumbered: update this list). Keep the text in a player's words.

issues.text: Only the English versions of the two games are supported; a game in another language is refused on the first start.
Campaign, War of the Ring, Save / Load and the Options screen are not available yet. Play skirmish against the computer or a LAN game.
The main menu has no 3D map behind it and no videos play; a few menu controls (sliders, check boxes, lists) are simplified or missing.
Menus are laid out for 1024x768: at other window sizes text and click targets can be slightly off. Widescreen camera framing may differ from the original.
Menus cannot be used with the keyboard or a gamepad, only with the mouse.
The computer opponent is incomplete: it builds a base, trains armies and attacks, but it does not yet defend well, expand, rebuild after losing its fortress or use heroes the way the original does.
Enemy buildings destroyed out of your sight disappear at once instead of staying in the fog until you look again.
Team colours are not shown on units and buildings.
Some sounds are missing: footsteps and other animation sounds, damage sounds, scripted music and large-battle ambience.
Every game is recorded as a replay automatically, but replays cannot be saved under a name yet, and the score screen's graphs are simplified.
LAN: the lobby looks different from the original in places, and the disconnect screen has no chat.
